repositories.name: nevingeorge/Negative-Weight-SSSP
repositories.description: Implementation of Bernstein-Nanongkai-Wulff-Nilsen 2022 near-linear negative-weight SSSP algorithm. Yale CPSC 490 senior project advised by Prof. Daniel Spielman.
repositories.notes: Includes graph format reader, configurable LDD, random seed support.

repositories.name: TAMREF/bcf23
repositories.description: Implementation of Bringmann-Cassis-Fischer 2023 'Negative-Weight Single-Source Shortest Paths in Near-Linear Time: Now Faster!' FOCS 2023.
repositories.algorithm: BCF23 O(m log^2(n) log(nW) log log n)

repositories.name: danalec/DMMSY-SSSP
repositories.description: Experimental C implementation of Duan-Mao-Mao-Shu-Yin STOC 2025 'Breaking the Sorting Barrier for Directed Single-Source Shortest Paths'. Claims 20,000x speedups over standard Dijkstra on large sparse graphs.
repositories.notes: Also available in Zig (DMMSY-SSSP-zig) and Rust (DMMSY-SSSP-rs) ports.

repositories.name: danalec/DMMSY-SSSP-rs
repositories.description: Rust port of DMMSY algorithm. Claims 5,000x+ speedup over traditional Dijkstra on large sparse graphs.

repositories.name: danalec/DMMSY-SSSP-zig
repositories.description: Zig port of DMMSY algorithm with manual control over optimizations and LLVM backend tuning.

repositories.name: alphastrata/DunMaoSSSP
repositories.description: Independent Rust proof-of-concept implementation of the Duan-Mao et al. SSSP algorithm from the 2025 paper.

repositories.name: fyezool/sssp-algo-benchmark
repositories.description: SSSP benchmark comparing sorting-barrier algorithm against Dijkstra with binary heap and simulated Fibonacci heap. Based on DMMSY paper.

repositories.name: giacobenin/pqs
repositories.description: Dijkstra's SSSP with Fibonacci and Binomial Heaps. Includes random graph generation and performance testing.
repositories.algorithm: Dijkstra with Fibonacci/Binomial heap O(m + n log n)
repositories.notes: Good reference for Fibonacci heap Dijkstra implementation.

benchmark_suites.name: 9th DIMACS Implementation Challenge: Shortest Paths
benchmark_suites.description: Standard benchmark for shortest path algorithms. Includes USA road network graphs from NY (264k nodes) to full USA (23.9M nodes, 58.3M arcs). Defines common file formats and benchmark protocols.
graph_types: Road networks (NY, BAY, COL, FLA, NW, NE, CAL, full USA)
benchmark_suites.notes: Still the gold standard for shortest path benchmarks. Public domain data.

benchmark_suites.name: openSVM/bmssp-benchmark-game
benchmark_suites.description: Bounded multi-source shortest paths benchmarks in multiple languages (Rust, C, C++, Nim, Crystal, Kotlin, Elixir, Erlang). Captures push counts, relax counts, wall-clock time, peak RSS.

benchmark_suites.name: Cassis-Karrenbauer-Nusser-Rinaldi SEA 2025 benchmarks
benchmark_suites.description: First practical implementation and experimental evaluation of near-linear negative-weight SSSP algorithms. Uses DIMACS-style graphs plus random hard instances.
benchmark_suites.notes: Shows practical performance gap between theoretical and implemented algorithms.
